name: How long does it typically take to paint a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to paint a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting a bathroom typically takes 1-3 days, depending on its size, the extent of prep work needed, and the number of coats required. Factors like existing wallpaper removal, patching, or significant color changes can extend the timeline. Frasheski Construction prioritizes efficient and thorough preparation, which can include protecting fixtures and surfaces, to ensure a smooth painting process and a high-quality finish within a predictable timeframe.
